thread:
mira: Quick favor — can someone run preflight benchmarks for cormorant-12b on ded-cluster-a? Need latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput at batch sizes 1/4/8, and memory profile. Target seq_len=1024.

jon: Ack, I can take this. When do you need results? Also which quantization profiles to try?

mira: Asap but within the day is fine. Try fp16 baseline + int8-qat if available. Also run with prefix cache enabled/disabled.

jon: Scheduling smoke now. Will run: bs=1/4/8, concurrency=1/2, seq=1024. Job id rb-bench-2387.

bench-bot: Scheduled job rb-bench-2387 on ded-cluster-a (queue: perf-small). ETA ~12m.

jon: Smoke done (fp16): p50=13.9ms p95=42ms p99=96ms @bs1. memory RSS ~8.1GB.

jon: int8-qat smoke: p50=15.7ms p95=55ms p99=118ms @bs1. memory RSS ~6.2GB.

alejandra: nice — can you also capture cold-start (new process) latency for a single request and a warm run with kv cache hit?

jon: Added cold-start: fp16 cold p95 ~220ms, warm p95 ~44ms. int8 cold p95 ~260ms, warm p95 ~55ms. KV cache enabled reduces p99 by ~10-15ms at bs1.

samir: Please also run concurrency=2 for throughput profile and note any OOMs at bs8. I'm worried about bigger batches when multiple requests interleave.

jon: Concurrency=2 results:
- bs1: throughput ~140 toks/sec, p99 ~110ms (int8)
- bs4: throughput ~520 toks/sec, p99 ~180ms (fp16)
- bs8: fp16 pushes memory to ~15.8GB — safe on ded-cluster-a (16GB card) but close to limit; int8 fits with ~11.2GB. No OOMs in our runs.

jon: Quick command used for reproducibility:
```bash
rb-run-bench --model cormorant-12b --seq_len 1024 --batch_sizes 1,4,8 --concurrency 1,2 --quant fp16,int8-qat --cache on,off --report-json /tmp/cormorant-prerun.json
```

bench-bot: Bench summary published: https://benchboard.internal/rb-bench-2387 (includes full traces, perf waterfall, and heap dumps).

mira: Great. Two follow-ups: 1) Add a canary config suggestion for rollout (prefer ded, fallback to hosted-gpu-small), 2) open a small PR with recommended batch/concurrency defaults and quantization profile.

jon: I'll draft the PR. Suggested defaults: fp16 for latency-sensitive endpoints, int8-qat for cost-sensitive throughput (default bs=4, concurrency=1). Add routing policy note for fallback.

samir: I'll reserve 2 cards on ded-cluster-a for the weekend canary window and sync with eng-sre.

alejandra: One small note — observed slight decoding jitter at seq_len 1024 with beam search enabled. Recommend disabling beam for canary.

mira: Good catch. Include that in the PR. Thanks everyone — closing this thread after PR link. :thumbsup:
